## Documentation Issue Description

A clear and concise description of what documentation needs to be updated, added, or fixed.

## Location

Where is the documentation that needs to be updated?
- File path: [e.g., docs/installation.md, README.md]
- Section/Header: [e.g., "Installation", "Configuration"]
- URL (if applicable): [link to documentation]

## Current State

Describe what the documentation currently says or what is currently missing.

## Proposed Improvement

Describe what the documentation should say or what should be added.

## Steps to Implement

If you have suggestions on how to improve the documentation:
1. Step 1
2. Step 2
3. Step 3

## Expected Outcome

What should users understand after reading the updated documentation?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the documentation issue here.
- Related issues: [link to any related issues]
- Affected versions: [if applicable]

## Type of Documentation Update

- [ ] Correction (fixing errors or inaccuracies)
- [ ] Clarification (improving existing content)
- [ ] Addition (new content needed)
- [ ] Removal (outdated or incorrect content)
- [ ] Restructuring (better organization needed)
